retail.prototype_evidence: No arguments are read; the only caller 0x004020D3 pushes nothing. EAX on the success path is Qvm_Cleanup's return value, which 0x004137C0-0x004137C4 leaves untouched; the failure path never returns, so the declared int32_t return is only observable on success.

retail.behavior: Load LOCAL:humanplayer/humanplayer.qsc; when the load returns a VM, execute it, clean it up and return the cleanup result; when it returns null, report the fatal error and halt.

findings: The corrected candidate calls Qvm_Load with the exact retail literal, then Qvm_Execute and Qvm_Cleanup in that order, and returns Qvm_Cleanup's result.
The failure branch calls Debug_Error with the exact format and the same path, then loops with no exit condition, matching the retail self-loop.
The guessing probe, the resource-system call and the wrong path are gone.
documented_differences: The candidate restores a callee-saved register before returning where retail re-pushes its esi copy.

limitations: No runtime capture exists, and the failure path halts, so the fatal branch cannot be observed in the candidate.
